harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `/srv/data` as a persistent LVM-backed XFS filesystem, demonstrated exact snapshot rollback after destructive changes, retained a fresh recovery snapshot, and verified persistence across a node1 reboot.
actions_performed: Installed LVM tooling and created dedicated snapshot-capable storage for `/srv/data`.
Configured automatic loop-device attachment, LVM activation, and filesystem mounting at boot.
Captured baseline hashes and created the `data_prechange` snapshot.
Modified two files, deleted one, and added an unwanted file.
Merged the earlier snapshot and verified exact restoration.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified storage, data, and snapshot recovery.

evidence.requirement: Keep application data under `/srv/data` recoverable through filesystem snapshots
evidence.summary: Created and mounted an LVM-backed XFS logical volume at `/srv/data`; enabled boot activation and retained the active `data_recovered` snapshot.

evidence.requirement: Capture exact application content in an earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Recorded hashes for all three original files and created `data_prechange`; every captured hash matched immediately afterward.

evidence.requirement: Modify the directory while preserving the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Live data was altered, deleted, and added so baseline validation failed, while the read-only earlier snapshot still passed every original hash.

evidence.requirement: Restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: The snapshot merge restored all three original files and hashes, restored the deleted ledger, and removed the post-snapshot unwanted file.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID was 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the new boot ID was 5608bb97-9afa-4626-bfbe-74d242767451; afterward the system and activation service were active, `/srv/data` was mounted read-write, live data passed every hash, and the retained snapshot independently passed every hash.

attempts.summary: Configured `/srv/data` as a persistent LVM-backed XFS filesystem, demonstrated exact snapshot rollback after destructive changes, retained a fresh recovery snapshot, and verified persistence across a node1 reboot.
